rv.q: Invisible Me is such a successful piece of writing and acting, which I enjoyed so much that four stars would be very stingy!
Warm and funny, relatable and touching, and impeccably played by the three actors, Invisible Me puts people in their 'senior' years centre-stage for a change.

Invisible Me tackles a rapidly expanding but under-represented experience with confidence and creativity. Its perspective is narrower than it should be, but still delivers both gut-punches and belly-laughs.
